summary: Learn supplier diversity and inclusive procurement with scorecards, Tier 2 reporting, and supplier development tools. Enroll to build practical capability.
lede: Supplier diversity training helps procurement, sourcing, supplier management, ESG and compliance professionals make inclusive procurement measurable. It covers setting spend baselines, designing inclusive RFP scorecards, checking supplier qualifications, and building outreach and Tier 2 reporting processes. Participants practice analyzing supplier-classification data, creating supplier outreach plans, and preparing dashboards and executive updates to track participation and inform sourcing decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you work in procurement, sourcing, supplier management, ESG, or compliance and need to make inclusive procurement measurable. It fits practitioners and managers who already know the procurement cycle and now need to strengthen supplier diversity execution, reporting, and stakeholder alignment. Procurement Managers responsible for inclusive sourcing governance and supplier mix. Strategic Sourcing Specialists who run RFPs with diverse supplier participation. Supplier Diversity Coordinators managing outreach, certification, and reporting workflows. Category Managers balancing commercial targets with inclusive procurement requirements. Procurement Officers maintaining supplier records and qualification documentation. ESG Managers aligning procurement outcomes with social value reporting. Compliance Managers reviewing supplier documentation and reporting controls. Supplier Development Leads supporting capability-building for diverse suppliers. Vendor Management Analysts tracking Tier 1 and Tier 2 spend metrics. Finance Business Partners reviewing procurement savings and supplier spend evidence.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample procurement or supplier spend data if available. Familiarity with sourcing events, supplier onboarding, or category reporting will help you complete the hands-on exercises efficiently.
